title: (Pwn2Own) Lexmark MC3224i snmpUTIL Improper Input Validation Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Lexmark MC3224i printers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the snmpUTIL binary. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of configuration files. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the admin user.
